desc: Derive offline reverse interpretation: label i goes to the P_i-th empty final position when processing i=N..1.
Implement Fenwick tree with O(N) initialization, kth empty position query, and point decrement update.
Read input, process i=N..1, store answer, and print final array.
Verify correctness/performance on samples, N=1, all P_i=1, all P_i=i, and a random small brute-force comparison.
